solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Meal is exceptionally good, adding pressure on middle

indicators.note: adding tells us an extra letter joins the word for exceptionally good
on middle places that extra letter in the centre of the word, between its two halves

parts.note: super means exceptionally good
P is the physics symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: A diner praises an evening meal, though something about the middle of it feels heavy.
explanation.definitionFit: Supper is an evening meal, so it is a type of meal.

clue.text: Convertible furniture really great, employed on vacation

parts.note: so means really, as in so good
fab, short for fabulous, means great

indicators.note: vacation means emptying, so the inside of employed is cleared out leaving its ends

explanation.surface: A worker on holiday raves about a convertible piece of furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A sofa bed converts from a couch into a bed, so it is furniture that changes form.

clue.text: Pair seen around Brazilian city earlier

indicators.note: seen around means the abbreviation for pair wraps the city's name

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro, often just Rio, is a Brazilian city

explanation.surface: A couple were spotted in a Brazilian city before.
explanation.definitionFit: Prior is a synonym of earlier, meaning coming before in time.

clue.text: Manoeuvring in trees, queen is lady on horseback

indicators.note: manoeuvring means moving around, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A queen riding among trees steers her horse.
explanation.definitionFit: An equestrienne is a female rider or performer on horseback.

clue.text: Attempt brief skipping run

indicators.note: skipping means leaving out, so the letter for run is dropped from the word

parts.note: brief means short
R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for a run

explanation.surface: Someone makes a quick try at something, cutting out the jogging.
explanation.definitionFit: To have a shot at something is an idiom for making an attempt or try.

clue.text: Rubbish and burnt remains under house on outskirts of Glasgow

indicators.note: in a down answer, under places the remains below the earlier letters
outskirts are the edges, so only the first and last letters of Glasgow

parts.note: ash is what remains after burning

explanation.surface: Scene of a house fire on the edge of Glasgow, with junk and ashes everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Hogwash is nonsense, the figurative sense of rubbish.

clue.text: Carried baby of French revolutionary

parts.note: a tot is a small child

indicators.note: revolutionary suggests turning over, so the French word is read backwards

parts.note: de is French for of

explanation.surface: Talk of a baby born to a French revolutionary.
explanation.definitionFit: To tote is to carry, so toted is the past tense, carried.

clue.text: Present that woman with accolade at last

parts.note: her refers to that woman

indicators.note: at last points to the final letter of accolade

explanation.surface: Finally giving a woman an award.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Present' looks like a verb, giving her the accolade, but it is the adjective meaning in attendance.
explanation.definitionFit: Here as an adjective means present, in attendance, as in a roll call.

clue.text: Flattery — dull quiet chaps taken in by it

parts.note: bland means dull

indicators.note: taken in by means held within, so it wraps around the other letters

parts.note: taken as written
sh is the sound for asking for quiet
chaps are men

explanation.surface: Boring, silent men are fooled by flattery.
explanation.definitionFit: Blandishment is coaxing flattery used to persuade someone.

clue.text: Following trouble you texted concerning lack of success

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references
to ail is to trouble
U is the text-message spelling of you
RE means concerning, about

explanation.surface: After a problem with a text message, someone laments that it didn't work.
explanation.definitionFit: A failure is a want of success, an attempt that did not come off.

clue.text: Lamp, perhaps, is not heavy

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a ..., of which a lamp is an example

explanation.surface: A remark that a lamp doesn't weigh much.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a source of illumination such as a lamp and also describes something of little weight.

clue.text: Composer in beret's changed name

indicators.note: changed tells us these letters are rearranged into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, the apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: A composer wearing a beret has altered his name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link word placing the composer in a hat, but it is part of the letters to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonard Bernstein was an American composer, best known for West Side Story.

clue.text: Help abridge Verdi opera

indicators.note: to abridge is to shorten, so the opera's title loses its final letter

parts.note: Aida is an opera by Verdi

explanation.surface: A request to cut a long Verdi opera down to size.
explanation.definitionFit: Aid is a synonym of help, as a noun or verb.

clue.text: Leave barren area

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to abandon or leave
second meaning: a dry, barren region

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for abandoning someone and a noun for an arid wasteland.

clue.text: Accommodating knight in Muscat, organised private room

indicators.note: accommodating means giving room to, so the knight's letter goes inside
organised means arranged, so the letters of Muscat are reordered

parts.note: N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A hotel in Muscat, capital of Oman, arranges a private room for a knight.
explanation.definitionFit: A sanctum is a private retreat, a room where one is free from intrusion.

clue.text: Man on board brig's regularly shunned hard work

indicators.note: every other letter of brig's is ignored, keeping the alternate ones

parts.note: H is the pencil abbreviation for hard
OP, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: A sailor on a ship's brig avoided heavy labour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man on board' suggests a sailor on the brig, but the board is a chessboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop is one of the chess pieces, which are often called men.

clue.text: Father's second to get on way

parts.note: pa is father, so pa's
to age is to get on in years

explanation.surface: A father's second child is about to set off.
explanation.definitionFit: A passage is a way through, such as a corridor or route.

clue.text: Container's more or less new

parts.note: CA, short for circa, means approximately

explanation.surface: A container is described as being nearly new.
explanation.definitionFit: A can is a metal container for food or drink.

clue.text: Conflict contained by extremely composed army

indicators.note: contained by means held inside the outer letters
extremely points to the extremes, the first and last letters of composed

parts.note: a row is a quarrel or conflict

explanation.surface: A calm army keeps the fighting under control.
explanation.definitionFit: An army can mean a large number of people, a crowd or multitude.

clue.text: Food containers in Greggs he'll salvage

indicators.note: in shows the answer sits inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A worker at Greggs, a British bakery chain, will rescue some food packaging.
explanation.definitionFit: Eggshells hold the egg inside, so whimsically they are containers for food.

clue.text: Chat about good jokes

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for chat goes round the other letter

parts.note: to gas is to chat idly

explanation.surface: Conversation about good jokes.
explanation.definitionFit: Gags are jokes, especially a comedian's quick funny lines.

clue.text: Understand desire to disregard years after 50

indicators.note: after places the shortened desire behind the numeral letter

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for 50

indicators.note: disregard means ignore, so that letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: to yearn is to desire

explanation.surface: After turning fifty, one learns to ignore age and follow one's wishes.
explanation.definitionFit: To learn something can mean to come to know or grasp it, close to understanding it.

clue.text: Frequently relax when leader's gone

indicators.note: the leader of the word is its first letter, which goes away

parts.note: to soften is to relax or ease

explanation.surface: Advice to unwind often once the boss has left.
explanation.definitionFit: Often and frequently are synonyms meaning many times.

clue.text: A danger at sea somewhere in the Caribbean

indicators.note: at sea means confused or all over the place, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A warning about a hazard on the water near a Caribbean island.
explanation.definitionFit: Grenada is an island nation in the eastern Caribbean.

clue.text: Tip political party to accept referendum in the end

indicators.note: to accept means to take something in, so the party's letters go around the extra letter

parts.note: the DUP is the Democratic Unionist Party of Northern Ireland

indicators.note: in the end points to the final letter of referendum

explanation.surface: A political party is advised to go along with a referendum result eventually.
explanation.definitionFit: A tip in British usage is a rubbish dump, and to tip is to dump.

clue.text: Not about to be enthralled by expert straight away

indicators.note: enthralled means held captive, so the turned word is held inside the word for expert

parts.note: an ace is an expert

indicators.note: about tells us the word not is turned round

explanation.surface: Someone refusing to be captivated by a specialist without delay.
explanation.definitionFit: At once is an idiom meaning immediately, without delay.
